values.note: 30-amp RV sites $48, 30/50-amp sites $53, per night for 2 people; $5 per extra person over 12 (6 maximum). A 23-ft rig fits the $48 sites B2 (26 ft) and B3 (28 ft).

values.note: Online through the campground's own booking page or by phone; deposit required, nonrefundable if cancelled within 48 hours of the reservation.

booking.source: https://www.canoeingthenew.com/rv-sites ('Reservations can be made using our online platform or by calling our office directly... 2 night minimum stay.'), read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: https://www.canoeingthenew.com/rv-sites ('All RV sites include water and electric hookup... We now offer both 30 AMP and 50 AMP electric hookups'), read 2026-10-22. Sewer cleared: it was derived from an Allstays 'full hookups' line; the operator lists water and electric only.

values.note: 14 RV sites (4 with 30 amp fitting 15-28 ft, 10 with 30/50 amp fitting 35-42 ft), 41 tent sites (riverfront plus overflow) and an island group tent site, besides apartments and studios. The earlier '49 sites' came from Allstays.

values.note: Closed for the 2026 season on October 12, 2026 ('See ya in April 2027!').

season.source: https://www.facebook.com/newrivercampgroundandcanoe/ (post of October 12, 2026: 'We have officially closed for the 2026 camping season... See ya in April 2027!'), read 2026-10-22

note: On the New River just south of the Virginia line (mailing address Independence, VA), with a mile of river frontage; riverbank tent sites, apartments and studios, picnic shelters, and tubing/kayak/canoe trips that end at the campground. Blue Ridge ~2,600 ft. --Claude
summary: The website is the campground's own (New River Campground and Canoe, Inc.; same business as the outfitter). Confirmed $48-53 (2 people) and the 2-night minimum; added the operator's Wix booking page, 50-amp electric with water, 56 sites (14 RV, up to 42 ft; a 23-ft rig fits $48 sites B2/B3), bathhouses and camp store, and the seasonal closing (closed Oct 12, 2026 until April 2027). Cleared sewer (Allstays-only). Google Maps 4.5 / 378, phone (336) 372-8793 matches; Google shows 'Temporarily closed', which is the off-season. No gateway within 40 km; not stayed at. Note: dropped the Allstays site count/full-hookup claim and other restated fields.
flags: Google Maps marks the listing 'Temporarily closed'; the operator's Facebook says this is the seasonal closing ('officially closed for the 2026 camping season... See ya in April 2027!', Oct 12 2026), so no status was recorded.
Rate is $48 for 2 people, just under the US$50 gate (no gateway within 40 km); a third person is +$5.
